content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit is a self-contained commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail. It combines free and paid tools into a unified system: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. The result? A fully operational online store that verifies payments on-chain, delivers products instantly, and stores data securely—all without relying on third-party platforms. This isn’t a patch; it’s a new architecture built for resilience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates on a decentralized model. When a buyer purchases a product, the payment is verified on-chain via NOWPayments. A webhook triggers the backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script) to log the order in Supabase or Google Sheets. Once confirmed, the system generates a secure, time-limited download link from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sends it to the buyer. Everything runs on edge infrastructure, ensuring low latency and high availability. Cloudflare’s global network ensures the store is accessible from anywhere, while blockchain payments eliminate geographic restrictions. The creator retains full ownership of the codebase and data, with no platform intermediaries.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is designed for digital creators in countries like Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines—regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products but lack reliable payment processing. COREMERCH’s solution removes the middleman, enabling direct sales with automatic payment verification and instant product delivery. It’s not just a tool; it’s a shift in control—from platforms to creators.
Blockchain payments remove geographic barriers entirely—sell to anyone, anywhere.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack’s components are chosen for their reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, scalable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without server management. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files efficiently. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with minimal fees and no buyer account requirements. Each component is open-source or freely available, ensuring no vendor lock-in. The Complete Builder Kit includes blueprints and templates for all configurations, allowing creators to deploy their stack in hours, not weeks.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, source code, and templates for five commerce stacks. Choose the stack that fits your needs—whether it’s the lightweight Sovereign Starter Stack or the robust Edge Commerce Stack. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure backend logic, and integrate NOWPayments. Load your products, test the system end-to-end, and launch. The kit includes a scaling playbook to handle growth. With this infrastructure, you’re not just selling—you’re building a sovereign commerce engine that works anywhere, for anyone.

Frequently Asked Questions
What makes COREMERCH different from platforms like Stripe or PayPal?

COREMERCH provides sovereign commerce infrastructure, not a payment gateway. Creators own the entire stack, from hosting to payment processing, eliminating platform dependencies. Payments are processed via blockchain, bypassing geographic restrictions.
Do I need technical expertise to deploy this system?
Basic technical knowledge is helpful, but the Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. Most creators can deploy their stack within 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook with strategies for handling increased traffic, optimizing performance, and adding more products.
What happens after I deploy my stack?
You retain full ownership and control. COREMERCH has no access to your system after deployment. It’s your infrastructure, running on your terms.
